description: Night photograph of the River Thames in London, letterboxed in black as if captured from a phone screen. The illuminated clock face of the Elizabeth Tower (Big Ben) at the Palace of Westminster stands in the background; the foreground shows moored houseboats/barges, a pier gangway with string lights along the embankment, and street lamps consistent with a view from near the Victoria Embankment. Q posted London photos like this as implied first-hand surveillance; the filename LisaMI6 implies a claim connecting a Lisa to MI6, though no person is visible in the image.
flags: Filename LisaMI6 is an unverified claim by the poster; no person appears in the photo and no MI6 connection is shown
